name: Venus zkSync uncapped wUSDM ERC-4626 oracle
summary: Venus priced wUSDM with an ERC4626Oracle that read convertToAssets without bounding donation-driven appreciation. The attacker borrowed wUSDM against flash-loaned WETH, redeemed and donated the USDM to the wUSDM vault to raise its rate, then liquidated its own wUSDM debt from a second account, seizing the WETH collateral at the inflated valuation.
notes: The governance execution configured the vulnerable ERC4626Oracle as wUSDM's enabled main oracle. The vwUSDM listing, collateral factor and caps were set in the same transaction; no later wUSDM oracle or market change precedes the exploit.

Loss is the vWETH and vwUSDM markets' net outflow in the exploit, with the 71.34 WETH liquidation share paid to Venus's ProtocolShareReserve netted back. It matches Venus's reported net loss of about $717k; the attacker kept only 86.72 WETH and 55,000 wUSDM, the rest of the wUSDM went into the donation.
Seventeen bot liquidations of other wUSDM borrowers in the following ~500 blocks used the still-inflated price but did not exercise the defect themselves, and are not listed as campaign.
